## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek, quiet, and unobtrusive individual. Described as lacking in willpower, he lives his life in a slow and unassertive manner.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent the earlier part of his life under the rule of his mother until his marriage to [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), at which point she took over managing him. On the occasion of his marriage, he planted June lilies. Following his eventual death, his widowed wife accepted an invitation to move in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

While [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is an outspoken community observer and frequent guest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Thomas shares a quieter home life with her, occasionally finding his household routine subject to the local news and political events his wife actively engages in.
